gl-32Hd.title: Google car: small red-black boat with several
gl-32Hd.summary: A small red and black boat with several people sitting in it, in a fjord far north on the east coast.

gl-35Vi.title: Google car: boat, white cabin, red roof
gl-35Vi.summary: A boat with a white cabin and red roof, near many west coast towns, though most coverage is around Aasiaat.

gl-3zSm.title: Houses: grey, on smooth light-grey rocks
gl-3zSm.summary: Unlike most houses here, these are commonly grey instead of colourful, and the ground is nearly all smooth light grey rocks (Tiilerilaaq).

gl-560C.title: Landscape: evenly tall shaped mountains across
gl-560C.summary: Evenly tall mountains of a particular shape on the other side of the fjord (Kangerluk).

gl-70nR.title: Landscape: icebergs, bright white range beyond
gl-70nR.summary: Southwest of Qaanaaq, icebergs in a large body of water and a wide mountain range beyond, bright white as the snow reflects light through thick clouds.

gl-7jL5.title: Google car: bright red boat
gl-7jL5.summary: A bright red boat on the east coast near Tiilerillaq (no clouds) and Kuummiit (somewhat overcast).

gl-9o2x.title: Google car: wooden fishing boat
gl-9o2x.summary: A wooden fishing boat found outside Ilulissat.

gl-9zdx.title: Google car: red rectangular car, very sunny
gl-9zdx.summary: A red boxy car in extremely sunny coverage, greener and less barren than most of the country (Qaqortoq).

gl-9zpv.title: Road: thick snow, sun sets along the road
gl-9zpv.summary: The road linking Sisimiut and Kangerlussuaq has thick snow on and around it. The sun sets along the road, so the west part is very bright and the east part very dark.

gl-BnZs.title: Landscape: streaky clouds, dry, sandy
gl-BnZs.summary: Many streaky clouds and a very dry look, with small bushes and sandy soil that feels almost arid (Kangerlussuaq).

gl-C6JG.title: Google car: black ATV with orange-purple bag
gl-C6JG.summary: Across the fjord from Narsarsuaq, a black ATV with an orange and purple bag at the front, tall green grass and unusually red dirt.

gl-ECUX.title: Coverage: large ice blocks in every direction
gl-ECUX.summary: About 20 km northeast of Narsarsuaq there is a small piece of coverage with large ice blocks all around.

gl-EyQH.title: Coverage: over fifty small separate pieces
gl-EyQH.summary: Coverage is split into well over fifty small separate parts, mostly on the southern half of the west coast but scattered along much of the coast. Parts differ in weather, season and landmarks, and many are hard to tell apart.

gl-FXn2.title: Google car: driver in black hoodie, sunset
gl-FXn2.summary: Driver in a black hoodie, near sunset on a very sunny day, with small bushes along the road, which is unusual here (Narsarsuaq).

gl-FkCT.title: Google car: black-and-white boat, blue roof
gl-FkCT.summary: A black and white boat with a blue roof, between Kuummiit and Tasiilaq.

gl-KNcY.title: Google car: windshield with red-white-black
gl-KNcY.summary: A windshield with a shiny red, white and black reflection and large round side mirrors. Very sunny, with thick melting snow along roads (Aasiaat).

gl-M8Aj.title: Landscape: large dark grey rocks over the
gl-M8Aj.summary: Large, dark grey rocks tower over Niaqornat.

gl-Mbzc.title: Google car: odd one-off vehicles
gl-Mbzc.summary: Most covered places have their own odd, unique vehicle, from a red tractor to a snowmobile with a big box on the front.

gl-Mja8.title: Google car: thin antenna on right side
gl-Mja8.summary: A thin antenna on the right side of the car, in very sunny and fairly green coverage (Narsaq).

gl-TjyY.title: Google car: grey boat
gl-TjyY.summary: A grey boat east of the capital.

gl-UFUr.title: Google car: round red ATV, pyramid mountain NE
gl-UFUr.summary: A round red ATV with a pyramid-shaped mountain often to the northeast. Shot just after sunset, so it is fairly dark (Kulusuk).

gl-W79I.title: Coverage: melting snow by roads
gl-W79I.summary: Lots of thawing snow beside the roads, the sun setting and a large body of water to the west (Kangaatsiaq).

gl-XJSY.title: Road: airport runway, widest paved road
gl-XJSY.summary: At Upernavik the airport runway is covered, making it by far the widest paved road in Street View here.

gl-bFc4.title: Road: large white truck
gl-bFc4.summary: The road east of Kangerlussuaq has a large white truck as the Google vehicle.

gl-c8bS.title: Landscape: barren, no trees, snow, fjords
gl-c8bS.summary: Very barren with no trees or tall plants, often snowy. Hills and mountains are common, and flat land is rare. Nearly all coverage is on the coast, so fjords and coastlines are everywhere.

gl-cDtt.title: Google car: grey Street View car in the
gl-cDtt.summary: The largest city is easiest to spot by its grey Street View car, and by simply being by far the biggest city.

gl-dIwn.title: Google car: round grey car, barely visible
gl-dIwn.summary: A round grey car, often barely visible, in bright coverage with thin clouds and yellow-green grass with reddish moss (Paamiut).

gl-dUCI.title: Google car: ATV with big grey handguards
gl-dUCI.summary: An ATV with large grey handguards on both sides, many very thin clouds and a somewhat green area (Tasiilaq).

gl-efSj.title: Landscape: sandy pyramid mountains
gl-efSj.summary: Sandy, pyramid-shaped mountains to the north and a wide sand beach below the village. Look for the shop named Pilersuisoq to find it (Siorapaluk).

gl-elNN.title: Google car: large all-white boat
gl-elNN.summary: A large, all-white boat between Narsarsuaq and the opposite shore.

gl-fhpx.title: Google car: boat with small rounded red bow
gl-fhpx.summary: A small, rounded red bow on a boat going south of Tasiilaq.

gl-gioP.title: Camera: Gen 3 trekker on many vehicles
gl-gioP.summary: All coverage uses the older Gen 3 trekker camera (blurrier, softer colours), mounted on all sorts of vehicles.

gl-hpPA.title: Coverage: many sharp snow-powdered mountains
gl-hpPA.summary: A short piece east of the capital shows many sharp, snow-dusted mountains. It is somewhat dark because of thick clouds and the sun hidden behind the mountains.

gl-i8tg.title: Google car: green ATV, beige-hat driver
gl-i8tg.summary: A green ATV with black bars and a driver in a beige hat (a few parts without it), in fairly sunny, bright coverage (Ilulissat).

gl-iCnR.title: Google car: blue ATV, wide mirrors
gl-iCnR.summary: A blue ATV with wide side mirrors, fairly overcast, with lots of yellow grass by the roads (Qeqertarsuaq).

gl-kJuo.title: Landscape: sharp mountain east, round one north
gl-kJuo.summary: Two distinct mountains, a sharp one to the east and a rounder one to the north, in slightly dark light from clouds and sunset (Kuummiit).

gl-kijo.title: Google car: mostly white boat
gl-kijo.summary: A mostly white boat with extremely tall antennas at the back, going into the fjord east of the capital.

gl-lm-53.title: Coverage: many different vehicles
gl-lm-53.summary: Many different vehicles took the coverage. Architecture and landscape look alike all over the country, and the overall feel is recognisable once you have seen it.

gl-mBWE.title: Google car: wooden box on ATV, purple beanie
gl-mBWE.summary: A brown wooden box at the front of the ATV and a driver in a purple beanie, on grey stony ground in very sunny coverage (Ittoqqortoormiit).

gl-mCK8.title: Landscape: sharp mountain north
gl-mCK8.summary: Two giveaways: a sharp mountain to the north and a green snowmobile with big black side mirrors. Most coverage shows at least one (Uummannaq).

gl-mRxQ.title: Google car: black snowmobile
gl-mRxQ.summary: A black snowmobile with side mirrors pointing straight up, in very overcast, grey coverage (Sisimiut).

gl-mmU2.title: Coverage: boat trekkers, many boat types
gl-mmU2.summary: Boat trekkers are very common, on many different kinds of boats.

gl-nAfG.title: Google car: red and black ATV, snowy mountains
gl-nAfG.summary: A red and black ATV in and around Kapisillit, northeast of the capital, with many snow-covered mountains in the distance.

gl-o1St.title: Google car: tractor, overcast and snowy
gl-o1St.summary: Coverage was taken by a tractor, which is very recognisable. It is overcast and fairly snowy (Maniitsoq).

gl-otNH.title: Houses: small colourful wooden houses, sparse
gl-otNH.summary: Small, colourful, simple wooden houses spaced quite far apart, even in cities. Larger cities have some bigger, plain buildings.

gl-qRJx.title: Landscape: huge monolithic mountain to the west
gl-qRJx.summary: A large monolithic mountain to the west identifies Ikerasak.

gl-tksi.title: Google car: boat with red square cabin
gl-tksi.summary: A boat with a red square cabin, at multiple spots on the west coast, mostly around Akunnaaq.

gl-tycC.title: Google car: small white boat, silver bow rail
gl-tycC.summary: A small white boat with a silver handrail on the bow, between Narsaq and Qaqortoq. The sun is in the west near Narsaq and in the east near Qaqortoq.

gl-uLDZ.title: Landscape: wide cloudy range across a fjord
gl-uLDZ.summary: North of Saattut, a wide mountain range shrouded in clouds across a fjord. Mostly dark muddy dirt roads and yellow grass tufts.

gl-w021.title: Google car: small white boat, brown wooden top
gl-w021.summary: A small white boat with a brown wooden top and lights and monitoring devices, between Tiilerilaaq and Tasiilaq.

gl-w6MY.title: Landscape: wide snowy range to the northeast
gl-w6MY.summary: A wide snow-covered mountain range to the northeast, very bright from the setting sun. A green ATV is a helpful extra hint (Igaliku).

gl-yWnN.title: Landscape: tall cliff to the east
gl-yWnN.summary: The settlement sits below a tall cliffside to the east, with mountains towering above (Ukkusissat).

gl-yr0f.title: Google car: boat, black box front
gl-yr0f.summary: A boat with a black box near the front and a chequered pattern on the bow, far north on the east coast. The west part is foggy and overcast, the east part clearer and sunny. A man in a black coat captains it.
